PENALTIES AND REVOKING FAA CERTIFICATES OR AUTH TO OPERATE UNDER

OR OTHER APPLICABLE LEGAL AUTHORITY. MITIGATION MAY RESULT IN THE
INTERFERENCE, INTERCEPTION, SEIZURE, DAMAGING, OR DESTRUCTION OF
UAS.

(SSI), ALL UNMANNED ACFT ARE PROHIBITED FM FLYING WI A STAND-OFF
